mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_audit_log (log_type, operator, module, content_type, summary, confidence, decision_basis, model, target_type) VALUES (#{logType}, #{operator}, #{module}, #{contentType}, #{summary}, #{confidence}, #{decisionBasis}, #{model}, #{targetType})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM admin_audit_log WHERE log_type = 'OPERATION' AND module = #{module} AND create_time >= #{start}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dept_audit_log WHERE log_type = 'OPERATION' AND module = #{module} AND create_time >= #{start}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM street_audit_log WHERE log_type = 'OPERATION' AND module = #{module} AND create_time >= #{start})

SELECT id, log_type, operator, module, content_type, summary, confidence, decision_basis, model, target_type, create_time FROM admin_audit_log
AND log_type = #{logType} AND operator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operator}, '%') AND module LIKE CONCAT('%', #{module}, '%') AND id = #{id} AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND (module IS NULL OR module != #{excludeModule})
AND ( summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR decision_basis LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR operator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR module LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR content_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR log_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appeal_parent p WHERE (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%')) AND LOCATE(p.appeal_no, summary) > 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appeal_child c WHERE (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%')) AND LOCATE(c.appeal_no, summary) > 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_work_order wo JOIN appeal_child c ON c.id = wo.source_appeal_id LEFT JOIN appeal_parent p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_order_appeal wa JOIN appeal_child c2 ON c2.id = wa.appeal_id WHERE wa.order_id = wo.id AND (c2.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%') OR c2.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{appealKeyword}, '%')))) AND LOCATE(wo.order_no, summary) > 0) )
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
